payload.acceptance_criteria: When a reader views the Starship prompt guide, its prompt example and segment list shall omit the disabled Git line metrics.
payload.description:
## Trigger
When the Starship template disables line metrics, I want the prompt guide to show the shipped prompt, so I can read its example without expecting a removed segment.

## Scope
- `docs/user-guide.md`
payload.requirements: Make only the two documentation corrections that follow from the approved metrics change; preserve the remaining prompt explanation.
payload.title: Align the Starship prompt guide with disabled metrics
